name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-06-05, at wavelengths from 0.95 to 4.47 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
